map.汇集北京、上海、广东等地律师服务收费政府指导标准，按案件类型与标的额给出参考区间: Collects government guidance fee standards for legal services in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong and elsewhere, giving reference ranges by case type and claim amount to help parties estimate fee levels; the law firm's quote governs.
map.填写「标的金额（元，民事/行政用）」。: Fill in 'claim amount (CNY, for civil / administrative)'.
map.委托律师前，按案件类型（民事/刑事/行政/计时/风险代理）估算收费参考区间。: Before engaging a lawyer, estimate the fee reference range by case type (civil / criminal / administrative / hourly / contingency).
map.财产案件多按标的额分段累计，风险代理最高不超标的额 30%。: Property cases are mostly charged by cumulative segments of the claim amount, and contingency fees may not exceed 30% of the claim.
map.了解一审、二审收费的一般规则，便于议价。: Understand the general rules for first and second instance fees to help with negotiation.
map.：按各地指导价区间，100 万财产案件律师费参考约 3.5 万–5 万元（分段累: : by local guidance price ranges, a 1,000,000 property case costs about 35,000 to 50,000 CNY in lawyer fees (cumulative by segment, varying by region and complexity).
map.：基础费 + 胜诉提成，提成一般不超过标的额 30%；如基础费 1 万 + 回款: : base fee plus success commission, the commission generally not above 30% of the claim; for example a 10,000 base fee plus 1,000,000 recovered × 15% = 150,000, total 160,000 (within the 30% cap).
map.律师费能风险代理所有案件吗？: Can all cases be taken on contingency?
map.不能。婚姻、继承、请求给付赡养费/抚养费、请求支付劳动报酬、行政赔偿、刑事案等依: No. Marriage, inheritance, claims for support or maintenance, claims for labour remuneration, administrative compensation and criminal cases may not be taken on contingency by law.
map.二审收费能减半吗？: Can second instance fees be halved?
map.曾代理一审又代理二审的，通常减半收费；具体由委托代理合同约定，各地指导价有差异。: A lawyer who handled the first instance and also handles the second usually charges half; the exact figure follows the engagement contract, and guidance prices differ by region.
